{{Infobox/Character |location = [[Carnival]] |location_page_description = Allows the player to play the [[Carnival#Minigames|Catch a Fish]] minigame in the {{Zone|Carnival}}. |x = -81.5 |y = 72 |z = 29.5 }} '''Carnival Fisherman''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{Zone|Carnival}} during the [[Carnival]] event.
